project.title: Microbial communities that degrade bacterial peptidoglycan
project.description: Methanogenic microbial communities were enriched from rice paddy soil and an anaerobic digester using peptidoglycan purified from gram-negative Escherichia coli and gram-positive Micrococcus luteus as the sole substrate. Microbial community analysis for the enriched cultures was performed on an Illumina MiSeq platform.
project.center_name: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science & Technology

runs: Illumina MiSeq paired end sequencing of SAMD00197854
